<!--
  A top bar whose first item opens a wide panel of link groups, each with an icon and a list, and an optional
  promo card. The page keeps `open`; opening on hover or click is a port contract. Axes: panel (open, closed),
  cols (2, 3), promo (none, card).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type MegaMenuProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  trigger: string;
  links: NavLink[];
  groups: MegaGroup[];
  promoTitle?: string;
  promoText?: string;
  panel?: "open" | "closed";
  cols?: "2" | "3";
  promo?: "none" | "card";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  trigger,
  links,
  groups,
  promoTitle,
  promoText,
  panel = "open",
  cols = "3",
  promo = "none",
} = defineProps<MegaMenuProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="header" class="relative border-b border-border bg-background" data-testid="mega-menu">
    <Container
      :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 py-4')"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-lg font-medium" data-testid="brand">
        {{ brand }}
      </Link>
      <Block tag="nav" class="flex-1" :aria-label="label">
        <Group gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
          <ButtonPlain
            type="button"
            class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"
            :aria-expanded="(((panel as string) === 'open') ? 'true' : 'false')"
            data-testid="mega-trigger"
          >
            {{ trigger }}
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-down" :size="16" />
          </ButtonPlain>
          <Link v-for="l in links" :key="l.id"
            :href="(l.href ?? '#/')"
            variant="default"
            :aria-current="((l.id === '') ? 'page' : undefined)"
            class="text-sm"
            data-testid="nav-link"
          >
            {{ l.name }}
          </Link>
        </Group>
      </Block>
    </Container>
  </Block>
  <Box v-if="((panel as string) === 'open')" class="border-t border-border bg-card" data-testid="mega-panel">
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'grid gap-8 py-6',
        (((promo as string) === 'card') ? 'md:grid-cols-[1fr_16rem]' : '')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Grid :cols="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1-3')" class="gap-6" data-testid="items">
        <Stack v-for="g in groups" :key="g.id" gap="2" data-testid="item">
          <Group gap="2" align="center">
            <LucideIcon :name="g.icon" :size="16" />
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ g.title }}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
            <ListItem v-for="item in g.links" :key="item">
              <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {{ item }}
              </Link>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
      <Stack
        v-if="((promo as string) === 'card')"
        gap="2"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        data-testid="promo"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="(promoTitle ?? '')" ratio="4/3" />
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ promoTitle }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ promoText }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Box>
</template>
